test_title: PYST 23: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F is sitting third to the left of A. A is sitting second to the left of G. G is sitting to the immediate right of E. B is sitting to the immediate left of D. What is the position of F with respect to E?
solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) F is sitting third to the left of A.

2) A is sitting second to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59e35bd474108edcb1f342e353380cbf7650f1d875369c156915c0e456cb102f.png] 

3) G is sitting to the immediate right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0eb4f6b1493834635f5ca19a55e27f7778cfc94e5a19c24071dcedec52eabc2a.png] 

4) B is sitting to the immediate left of D.

After positioning B and D only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7f575abb4948913f5f3e7b5443160a681d89d1468145d2c9bf02d5dc5b1bcf2.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, F is third to the right E.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
